project_name.justification: The text refers to the project as the 'MacBride Base and Precious Metals Project' and the 'MacBride Zinc-Copper Deposit'.

company_name.justification: Corazon Mining Limited (ASX: CZN) (Corazon or Company) is pleased to announce it has entered into an agreement for the acquisition of three drill-defined zinc-copper-gold deposits...

ceo_buyer.justification: This announcement has been authorised on behalf of Corazon Mining Limited by Managing Director, Mr. Brett Smith.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Corazon, via wholly owned Canadian subsidiary 5918139 Manitoba Inc, will acquire 100% of the mineral tenure (listed in Table 1 and shown in Figures 1 and 4) for C$153,600.

primary_commodity.justification: The announcement is titled 'High Grade Zinc Acquisition' and the text describes the acquisition of 'three zinc-copper-gold deposits', with the 'high-grade MacBride Deposit' being the 'headline acquisition' with representative drill holes including '10.7m @ 9.98% Zn'.

currency.justification: Corazon, via wholly owned Canadian subsidiary 5918139 Manitoba Inc, will acquire 100% of the mineral tenure (listed in Table 1 and shown in Figures 1 and 4) for C$153,600.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The project's share is C$51,200, calculated as one-third of the total C$153,600 acquisition cost for three deposits (MacBride, Wellmet, and Barrington). The text states the total payment is 'C$153,600' for the 'acquisition of three drill-defined zinc-copper-gold deposits'.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction was for cash only.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The payment was explicitly for cash, so this field is null per the data extraction hierarchy.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned in the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned in the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in meters was mentioned.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No specific exploration commitment value was mentioned as part of the acquisition agreement.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The vendor, Mr PC Dunlop, will retain a 2% Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) over the ground, with the Company retaining a right to purchase up to 1% of the NSR for C$500k per 0.5%.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states that a subsequent staking action 'increases the MacBride project area from ~26km2 to ~56km2', indicating the project area after the acquisition and before the staking was approximately 26 km2.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The Company has physically staked and made applications for new Mining Claims that increases the MacBride project area from ~26km2 to ~56km2...

resource_size.justification: The text explicitly states the project does not have a current resource: 'The mineral endowment defined by this drilling has been extensively published within historical reports and in recent Canadian company reports as an “historical estimate” under NI 43-101, and is not a current mineral resource under the Canadian code or Australia’s JORC.'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: Corazon Mining Limited (ASX: CZN) (Corazon or Company) is pleased to announce the strategic expansion of its MacBride Base and Precious Metals Project...
